decisions.reason: It builds directly on our core airfield lighting and control know-how, fits our in-house R&D strengths, and the strong launch positioning suggests we can keep learning from deployments and improve it commercially.

An air situation display is closely related to our established surveillance and integrated-operations capabilities, so our existing knowledge base makes it likely that we can refine and commercialize it effectively.

The airport systems training program leverages our installed-base experience and service organization, and because it is strongly complementary to our core solutions it should remain valuable with limited development risk.

The airfield ground lighting training course is related to our business but showed the weakest market signal as only a brief mention, and its narrow scope makes it less strategic than broader integrated solutions and training offers.

The airport collaboration software tool matches our strategic move toward real-time information sharing and collaborative decision-making, and our system-integration knowledge gives us a strong absorptive-capacity advantage in improving it.

The multilateration surveillance system is technologically close to our established airport surveillance activities, and with internal R&D in a growing innovative industry we are well placed to absorb feedback and advance the product.
